title: Four-context finite-member history accounting and conditional recurrence interface
question: Does the fixed-support Q3 word and its adjoint admit exact four-context finite-member history accounting, and what four-context Cauchy coefficient follows if the explicit EXP-001151 recurrence and response hypotheses hold?
method: Load the EXP-001153 finite-support two-sided Duhamel seed and use its one-orientation squared remainder coefficient for both real-time signs.
Reverse every configuration-character amplitude to represent W* and verify that the kinetic even powers and force l1 square are unchanged.
Count the two orientation pairs and all four W/W* time-sign contexts, retaining the full triangle factor for each pair.
Reuse the explicit EXP-001151 recurrence fixture only conditionally: compute the weighted step 31/18, the distance-10 six-step response envelope and the four-context time-integrated coefficient.
Recompute the bounded-C1 same-form and cross-form product costs from EXP-001150, reproduce all rational values independently and compile Lean R324.
finding: Primary 19/19, independent 19/19, integrated 28/28, and Lean R324 compile PASS. The adjoint context has the same one-context squared bound 83497217154884689002533/43535646720. Each orientation pair has squared bound 83497217154884689002533/10883911680, and the four-context squared sum is the same value because it is four times the one-context bound. Under the explicit EXP-001151 recurrence hypothesis, the weighted step factor is 31/18, the distance-10 response envelope is 887503681/34828517376, and the four-context conditional Cauchy coefficient is 887503681/26121388032. The bounded-C1 product costs remain 81/4 and 1701/4.
decision_reason: The finite-time seed now has exact W/W* and positive/negative-time accounting, so the four-context norm bookkeeping needed by a two-sided QFT route is explicit. The recurrence calculation is a useful conditional bridge and doubles the declared orientation count correctly. It does not prove the actual quartic Q3 recurrence, first or double commutator spatial decay, modular response, or any volume-uniform limit; those remain named open gates.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing four-context finite-member accounting plus conditional recurrence interface. It computes a consequence of explicit hypotheses and does not prove those hypotheses, a thermodynamic dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
